constraints: Up to 1000 maps; 0 < nStation < 20 with unique names of 1-30 lowercase letters or digits; fees 0..1000; 0 < nPath < 20 roads of 1..1000 km, parallel roads allowed; 0 < nQuery < 10; passengers 1..10000.
Query endpoints differ and the minimum-cost station sequence is unique; fare = cost*1.1/passengers rounded half up to cents; blank line between maps only.
independentMethod: Enumerate every simple path between the query stations by depth-first search, assert that exactly one attains the minimum cost, and round the fare with exact rational arithmetic.

mutations.label: Charges one taka per kilometer when relaxing
Truncates the fare instead of rounding
